details: Haunted island trail on September 26 and October 2–3, 9–10, 16–17, 23–24 and 30–31, 2026.
Haunt 8 p.m.–midnight; ticket sales begin 7:30 p.m.; park gates close 11:30 p.m. Weather permitting.
General admission is sold at the gate; online tickets use a selected time window. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. All sales final.
Rough trail: stay on the path and do not run. No flashlights, smoking, open flames or weapons. Actors do not intentionally touch visitors; do not touch actors. Groups may be combined or split.
Accessibility accommodations are unconfirmed. Location is approximate; Directions use the visitor address.
Indoor haunted house on October 9–10, 16–17, 23–24 and 30–31, 2026, 7 p.m.–midnight.
Use your purchased entry slot. Tickets are non-refundable. Adult 13+ and youth 6–12 ticket categories are listed; this does not establish an under-6 policy.
High-gore, intense indoor scares. Accessibility and accompanied-minor requirements are unconfirmed; check the operator before booking.
Location is approximate. Directions use the visitor address.
Volunteer-run haunted house, October 23–24 and 30–31, 2026, 7–10 p.m.
Paid admission with live actors, animatronics and a vortex tunnel. Any lights-on matinee is unconfirmed; check the operator.
Accessibility and accompanied-minor requirements are unconfirmed. Location is approximate; Directions use the visitor address.
The 2026 ticket calendar lists September 26; October 2–3, 9–10, 16–17, 22–25 and 29–31, with 7 p.m. sessions.
Last admission and closing time are unconfirmed; check your selected session. General admission and fast-pass tickets are offered online and at the gate.
Recommended for ages 12+; no strict minimum age. No-touch by default; do not touch actors, props or walls. Strobe-lit corridors.
All sales final. Check severe-weather updates and accessibility arrangements before travel.

The 2026 calendar confirms September 19, 25–26; October 2–3, 9–10, 16–18, 23–25 and 29–31. Check the operator for any later date.

Two haunted attractions have separate or combo tickets; the paintball gallery is first come, first served. Cash or credit accepted at the box office.
Fog, lights and animatronics are used. Age guidance, accompanied-minor rules and accessibility accommodations are unconfirmed.
Location is approximate. Directions use the visitor address.

Friday/Saturday sessions run 7–11 p.m.; October 18, 25, 29 and November 1 run 7–9 p.m. November 1 is Blackout Night.
Age guidance, accessibility and effects restrictions are not verified here; confirm with the organizer before booking.

Selected Friday/Saturday nights October 9–31, 2026, 7–11 p.m.; the operator may remain open for queued guests.
Tickets are available online or on site. Physically demanding with strobes, fog, low visibility and wet conditions.
The operator advises children under 10 not to participate. Casts, medical braces and crutches are not admitted. Accessibility arrangements are unconfirmed.

Three attractions at one location: Haunted Barn, Haunted Hayride and Creepy Carnival. Selected nights October 2–November 1, 2026.
Friday/Saturday 7–11 p.m.; Sunday 7–10 p.m. Tickets are sold only at the ticket booth. Cash and major cards accepted; free parking.
Age guidance, accompanied-minor rules and accessibility arrangements are unconfirmed; check the operator before travel.

Ages 13+ recommended; guests 16 and younger must be accompanied by an adult. The operator says wheelchairs and mobility scooters can access the haunt.
Indoor attraction with a covered overflow line. Strobes, fog, loud sound and strong smells are used. No masks or props; no recording inside.
The October 17 lights-on children’s matinee is a separate session and is not included in these regular haunt hours.

Hours vary. The final November 7 session is 7–10 p.m.; join the line at least 10 minutes before closing to guarantee entry.
Recommended for ages 13+, with parental discretion. Children cannot be carried inside. No pets, weapons, masks or outside food/drink. Accessibility arrangements are unconfirmed.

All Halloween visitors must park at 301 W 2nd Street in Lockport and take the shuttle. Do not route to the mansion at 3101 Canal Street.

Guests under 16 require a parent or guardian; not recommended under 12. Outdoor woodland walking is part of the experience; closed-toe shoes are recommended. Accessibility arrangements are unconfirmed.
